description: This file defines the class FormattedTextFrame, which manages the formatting and rendering of a text frame within the PDF document, including layout calculations, area provisioning, and rendering info handling.

classes.name: FormattedTextFrame
classes.description: A class representing a formatted text frame within a PDF document, responsible for layout, formatting, and rendering of text areas.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Initializes formatting of the text frame and computes total content height.

methods.name: GetNextArea
methods.description: Provides the next layout area for text rendering if available.

methods.name: ProbeNextArea
methods.description: Placeholder method for probing next area, currently returns null.

methods.name: AreaFieldInfos
methods.description: Property exposing the associated FieldInfos object.

methods.name: StoreRenderInfos
methods.description: Stores the list of render information objects for later use.

methods.name: IsAreaBreakBefore
methods.description: Indicates whether there is a break before the current area, always returns false.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Returns the stored render info array or null if none.

methods.name: PositionVertically
methods.description: Decides whether to position vertically; always returns false.

methods.name: PositionHorizontally
methods.description: Positions the content area horizontally based on alignment and margins.
